sentences.text: Get the marine forecast before every trip.
The National Weather Service issues coastal waters and offshore forecasts, available online and broadcast continuously on NOAA Weather Radio.
A small craft advisory is issued for winds roughly in the twenty to thirty-three knot range, or for hazardous seas, with exact thresholds varying by region.
A gale warning means thirty-four to forty-seven knots.
A storm warning means forty-eight to sixty-three knots.
A hurricane force wind warning means sixty-four knots or more.
A special marine warning covers short-lived hazards like severe thunderstorms and waterspouts.
